title: CI green before merge
problem: A green check on another commit says nothing about the candidate.
rationale: Product merge holds on pending/missing/failing/unreachable required CI. Skipped/neutral do not silently equal Success. See section 7.3.
applicability: Candidates for a project whose selected merge prerequisites require CI.
baseline_policy: No legacy waiver for required verification or release prerequisites.

target_check.deterministic: read-only CI adapter verifies required workflow/check identities and successful conclusions for the exact commit/candidate, not repository-wide “latest green”; trusted local combined-tree checks when the host runs only branch-tip CI.
target_check.limits: **D:** read-only CI adapter verifies required workflow/check identities and successful conclusions for the exact commit/candidate, not repository-wide “latest green”; trusted local combined-tree checks when the host runs only branch-tip CI. **R:** suite adequacy.
target_check.configuration: Project-approved native configuration, immutable source/tool/config pins and applicable evidence mappings; Product merge holds on pending/missing/failing/unreachable required CI. Skipped/neutral do not silently equal Success. See section 7.3.

expected_evidence: **D:** read-only CI adapter verifies required workflow/check identities and successful conclusions for the exact commit/candidate, not repository-wide “latest green”; trusted local combined-tree checks when the host runs only branch-tip CI. **R:** suite adequacy.
repair: Run the required named CI checks on the exact candidate and wait for successful conclusions; another commit cannot supply the result. Missing prerequisites remain Unsupported/Error.

delivered_coverage.reason: DH-M1 supplies descriptor references only; guidance installation, runner and target check coverage are not delivered.
